verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing docs mention that "ChatGPT data controls" apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including Computer Use screenshots. This implies user-facing data controls exist, but nothing says they include a model-training opt-out. The /memories controls govern memory use, not training, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a model-training opt-out toggle, details on its scope and defaults (per-chat vs. account-wide, temporary chats, workspace/enterprise defaults), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
